newsitem.title: USA: Ambac qualifies five issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: Ambac qualifies five issues for bond insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Inc on Tuesday said that it qualified for bond insurance following five municipal bond issues, which are scheduled to be sold competitively:
--Bloomfield, School District, N.M., $4 million of general obligations (GOs).
--Mohawk Central School District, N.Y., $9 million GOs.
--New Mexico State, $64.825 million GOs Capital Improvement.
--Tulsa County Independent School District #5, Okla., $4.740 million Combined Purpose.
--Highland Village, Texas, $4.090 million Tax and Revenues.
